annotations.title: Search opinions and doctrine (CADA, Défenseur des droits, rapporteurs publics, BOFiP, CNIL)

description:
Opinions of the CADA (access to administrative documents), decisions of the Défenseur des droits, conclusions of the CE's rapporteurs publics, BOFiP (tax guidance), Code du travail numérique, CNIL deliberations. These are NOT court decisions: an opinion does not bind the judge. Keywords in French. Read a document: get_decision(id=…). For conclusions (ariane_crp), the case number is `numero`; `doc_id` is an internal identifier.

Example: search_doctrine(query="communication dossier médical", source="cada")

query.description: keywords in French (all required); "exact phrase" in double quotes; OR/AND/NOT/NEAR in UPPERCASE between two words are operators (NEAR = within 10 words); lowercase words are plain words; symbols (* ( ) …) are ignored.
query.title: Query

source.description: optional filter among cada, ddd, ariane_crp, bofip, ctn, cnil (CNIL deliberations)
source.title: Source

name: search_doctrine
